Definition: properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative)
BiblicalUsage: When is the cry of a believer who cannot see the end: David asks how long the LORD will wait, and when he will come and appear before God. Isaiah asks the same after his vision of the throne: Lord, how long?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe 'how long' is one of the most honest prayers in the Bible, and God never rebukes it: He answers it in His own time, and the waiting itself is part of the faith.
